cta.body: Togena helps organizers list terms, keep track of places and see applications and payments in one place.
cta.title: Ready to list your first event?

description: Togena helps organizers list terms, keep track of places and see applications and payments in one place. Participants apply from a link, without signing up.

capacity.body: Rooms and their number of beds set the available capacity. An event can use shared rooms or split them by gender.
capacity.title: Capacity by rooms

multiTerm.body: List several terms with prices for one event. Applicants pick one or more of them from the link.
multiTerm.title: Applications for several terms

payments.body: For confirmed places you see the amount due. The organizer sees who has already paid and who hasn't yet.
payments.title: Payment overview

features.title: What you can do in Togena

waitlist.body: After submitting, the status of each term is visible. When a term fills up, the applicant can wait as a substitute.
waitlist.title: Confirmation and waitlist

participants.body: Applicants pick one or more terms from the link and see the status of each one after submitting.
participants.title: Participants apply from a link, without signing up

title: Registrations for events with multiple terms

camps.body: Terms, rooms and participants' payments in one place.
camps.title: Summer camps

conferences.body: Applications without e-mail chains and spreadsheets.
conferences.title: Conferences and workshops

types.description: From children's camps to conferences and sports training weeks.
types.title: For every kind of event

trips.body: Capacity by rooms and an overview of substitutes.
trips.title: Training weeks and trips
